purpose: Authoritative placement, identity, snapshot, and reconciliation contract for the CIPHOS lakehouse and graph projection.

identifiers.source_batch_id: A deterministic SHA-256 digest of the ordered source-file checksums for one ingestion run.
identifiers.silver_snapshot_id: The published source_batch_id from which a graph projection is constructed.
identifiers.graph_snapshot_id: A unique immutable graph-release identifier that records silver_snapshot_id, manifest_version, and application_revision.
identifiers.run_id: A caller-supplied idempotency key for a graph calculation and its Gold publication.

snapshot_rules: A graph can be built only from one published Silver snapshot.
Gold rows must carry compatible source_snapshot_id and graph_snapshot_id.
The supplied export is a current-source snapshot. It does not establish business-effective history or a latest-value claim.
A graph build records a content digest of the files it actually loaded so declared lineage can be verified rather than trusted.

bronze.source_row_number_semantics: The 1-based data row number in the original CSV, excluding the header. It is stamped during upload, not inferred from file order in the query engine.

silver.provenance_grain: one row per tag-property value and source document
silver.enriched_grain: one row per tag-property value; source documents are aggregated so the enriched view never fans out

graph_projection.endpoint_policy: reject projection candidates with any relationship endpoint absent from the allowlisted nodes
graph_projection.relationship_identity: one relationship per source node, target node, and relationship type; properties are updated in place and never create a parallel edge
graph_projection.isolation_policy: a candidate projection is built in a database that is not the active serving database, and is activated only after validation

gold.asset_cyber_exposure_grain: one row per source asset, impacted asset, calculation path or score, and run_id
gold.path_hop_grain: one row per run_id, path, and hop number
